decisions.decision: Use batch processing for weekly demand data
decisions.context: The system forecasts weekly demand per store and product, so the brief calls for a recurring weekly run. The design space compares batch processing with real-time stream processing (d:15).
decisions.rationale: The weekly forecast cadence supports batch processing; the brief gives no real-time requirement (d:15, v:15.1).
consequences: Run processing on a weekly schedule.
Keep historical inputs available for reruns.

decisions.decision: Use a data version repository for reproducible forecasts
decisions.context: Reproducing a forecast for any past week requires identifying the data used for that run. The design space includes a dedicated data version repository and versioning in a code repository (d:11).
decisions.rationale: A data version repository directly supports identifying the historical input data for a forecast rerun (d:11, v:11.1).
consequences: Retain dataset versions used by production runs.
Track each run against its input version.

decisions.decision: Train models in batches for the weekly forecast run
decisions.context: The brief describes weekly forecasts and a small team owning the pipeline end to end. The design space contrasts batch, incremental, and hybrid learning (d:19).
decisions.rationale: Batch training aligns with the weekly run and keeps the pipeline simpler for a three-person team (d:19, v:19.1).
consequences: Retrain on a scheduled batch cadence.
Model updates arrive with a training run.

decisions.decision: Use CI/CD automation to deliver model changes
decisions.context: The team wants new model ideas to reach production quickly without disrupting the weekly run. The design space compares CI/CD pipelines, scripts, orchestration, and no automation (d:8).
decisions.rationale: A CI/CD pipeline supports automated delivery and faster iteration; the design point with this choice and batch processing was novel and unattested, with no warnings (d:8, v:8.1; d:15, v:15.1).
consequences: Maintain delivery checks as the pipeline evolves.

decisions.decision: Test trained model quality before release
decisions.context: Model ideas should reach production without breaking the weekly run, so changes need checks before release. The design space lists model quality testing and unit, integration, and service tests (d:26).
decisions.rationale: Testing trained model quality provides a release check relevant to new forecasting models (d:26, v:26.9).
consequences: Define and maintain model quality criteria.
Block releases that fail those criteria.

decisions.decision: Keep a rollback path for production models
decisions.context: New model ideas must reach production without breaking the weekly forecast run. The design space includes rollback to a previous version and multiple or single versions in production (d:10).
decisions.rationale: Rollback gives the team a recovery option if a new model disrupts the weekly run (d:10, v:10.2).
consequences: Provide a way to switch back after a faulty release.
